$comment: Storefront kits by NAICS prefix; the longest matching prefix wins. The pipeline's anchors carry self-reported codes from DataSF g8m3-pdis in both the 2017 and 2022 NAICS vintages (e.g. pharmacies appear as 446110 and 456110), so each kit lists both. Every kit is unnamed: signText is null and the sign slot stays blank.

types.label: Bar
types.naicsNote: 722410 Drinking Places (Alcoholic Beverages), same code in 2017 and 2022.

types.label: Full-service restaurant
types.naicsNote: 722511 Full-Service Restaurants (2012+), 722110 in 2007. 722 alone (and 722514 cafeterias) falls back here.

types.label: Cafe
types.naicsNote: 722513 Limited-Service Restaurants and 722515 Snack and Nonalcoholic Beverage Bars (coffee shops); 722211 and 722213 are their 2007 codes.

types.label: Grocery and deli
types.naicsNote: 4451 Grocery and Convenience Retailers (445110 supermarkets, 445120/445131 corner stores); 4452 Specialty Food (meat, fish, produce, delis).

types.label: Bakery
types.naicsNote: 445291 Baked Goods Retailers; 311811 Retail Bakeries (bake on site). The morning line outside is where the Bot Hunt line-stander works.

types.label: Salon and personal care
types.naicsNote: 812112 Beauty Salons, 812113 Nail Salons, 8121xx other personal care. Barbers (812111) have their own kit.

types.label: Laundromat
types.naicsNote: 812310 Coin-Operated Laundries and Drycleaners; the rest of 8123 falls back here.

types.label: Pharmacy
types.naicsNote: Pharmacies and Drug Stores: 446110 in NAICS 2017, 456110 in NAICS 2022. Other health retail (4461xx, 4561xx) stays generic retail.

types.label: Florist
types.naicsNote: Florists: 453110 in NAICS 2017, 459310 in NAICS 2022. Players fire flowers, so these are a natural place to restock.

types.label: Generic retail
types.naicsNote: Retail Trade, sectors 44-45: anything without a more specific kit (clothing, hardware, books, liquor, electronics...).
